exposure: echocardiographic parameters (left ventricular volume, left atrial volume, E/A ratio, global longitudinal strain)
cohort: The study included 76 pregnant women with low-risk congenital heart disease, with a median age at delivery of 27 years.
finding: An increase in left atrial volume followed by mild left ventricular diastolic dysfunction is related to peripartum cardiac events in low-risk pregnant women with congenital heart disease.
